In detail

Tor Fiscale is best known for the medieval tower and the adjoining Parco degli Acquedotti, part of the Appia Antica archaeological park system, with residential streets around it. Searches turned up only tourism, archaeology and park-management material, with no crime or safety reporting specific to the neighbourhood. No specific safety concerns documented in recent local press for this area.
